meta.name: geomaster
meta.description: Comprehensive geospatial science skill covering remote sensing, GIS, spatial analysis, machine learning for earth observation, and 30+ scientific domains. Supports satellite imagery processing (Sentinel, Landsat, MODIS, SAR, hyperspectral), vector and raster data operations, spatial statistics, point cloud processing, network analysis, cloud-native workflows (STAC, COG, Planetary Computer), and 8 programming languages (Python, R, Julia, JavaScript, C++, Java, Go, Rust) with 500+ code examples. Use for remote sensing workflows, GIS analysis, spatial ML, Earth observation data processing, terrain analysis, hydrological modeling, marine spatial analysis, atmospheric science, and any geospatial computation task.

copy.tagline: 处理多源遥感影像和地理数据，产出空间统计与环境研究成果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是地学研究者或GIS从业者,常处理卫星影像与空间数据。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are in geospatial science and regularly handle satellite and spatial datasets.

howto.what: 装上后，当你提出地理空间任务时，Claude 会按该技能的知识给出对应代码与操作步骤，例如读取卫星影像、计算指数、做空间连接等。
howto.when: 当用户提出遥感、GIS 或空间分析等地理空间计算或数据处理需求时触发。

say.text: 请帮我用哨兵二号影像算植被指数 NDVI。
say.note: Claude 会提供读取与计算的代码。

say.text: 用 GeoPandas 对两个矢量文件做空间连接并统计。
say.note: 会给出可运行的连接与聚合代码。

say.text: 把这份 GeoTIFF 转为 COG 格式并验证。
say.note: 会演示分块读写与 COG 写入/校验代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you request geospatial tasks, Claude will provide runnable code and steps from the skill—such as reading satellite imagery, calculating indices, or performing spatial joins.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for remote sensing, GIS, or spatial analysis tasks—or any geospatial computation/data processing request.

say_en.text: Help me compute the NDVI vegetation index from Sentinel-2 imagery.
say_en.note: Claude will provide code to read and calculate.

say_en.text: Use GeoPandas to perform a spatial join between two vector files and summarize.
say_en.note: Will give runnable join and aggregation code.

say_en.text: Convert this GeoTIFF to a COG format and validate it.
say_en.note: Will show tiling/COG writing and validation code.
